Reset This Home
Wipes rooms, devices, integrations, automations, scenes and dashboards back to a clean commissioned state — the owner account stays and the home remains set up. The OS and ProOS add-ons are untouched. A recovery backup is saved first.
Factory Reset
Returns the box to a brand-new install — clears the owner account and onboarding too, so the next installer starts from “Set up this home”. The OS, ProOS add-ons and dashboards stay. A recovery backup is saved first.

ProOS Music
Linking ProOS Music turns the resident's Music page into a full library — search, queues, playback and cross-brand grouping across every speaker. Without it, ProOS still runs natively on Sonos and HEOS with their saved favourites and same-brand grouping. Add it for AirPlay or Spotify-Connect homes, for one searchable library across brands, or for cross-brand groups.

Apple Home
Publishing to Apple Home lets the residents see and control this home's lights, switches, locks, blinds, climate and fans from the Apple Home app, Control Centre, the Lock Screen and Siri — on every iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch in the household, alongside their existing Apple TVs and HomePods. ProOS exposes one secure bridge; nothing leaves the home, and the alarm system's outputs are never published.

Publish to Apple Home first, then choose what to expose.
Nothing is exposed unless it's switched on here. Each item shows the kind of accessory it becomes in Apple Home. Switches, speakers, TVs and the Services area are off by default — turn on only what this home should control from Apple. Use the search box to jump to a room or device.
Rooms live on Apple's side, not ours — a bridge can't create or move Apple Home rooms. But when you add this bridge in the Home app it walks every accessory one at a time and lets you create a new room or pick an existing one for each; the list here is grouped by your ProOS rooms to make that match obvious. (If you tapped through quickly they all land in the Default Room — re-open each in Home and set its room, or remove & re-add the bridge to run the room prompts again.)

How Setup Works
Three areas, used together
1
Rooms and Labels · the room is the unit
Open a room and set it up in one place — its devices and their roles, the display's inputs, TV audio — then Save Room to generate its one-touch activities. Do each room, room by room.
2
Devices · the library
Where devices live. Pair what's discovered on the network and drop each into a room. You can also add a device straight from inside a room while you commission it.
3
Automations and Scenes
Room activities are generated automatically when the room is saved and edited in the room. This is where broader rules, scenes and macros across the home live.
A device only appears for the homeowner once it's in a room. Scenes are the lighting and device states you publish.
